dct_description_sm:
Overview

This feature service provides a point-based inventory of fire hydrants maintained by Westbank First Nation. It supports operational access to hydrant location and asset information for fire protection, water utility coordination, and field reference.

Feature Layer

  • WFN Hydrants - Contains hydrant locations and related asset attributes such as description, source, account and location references, civic address, grid reference, manufacturer and model details, outlet configuration, number of ports, color, operating characteristics, main and pipe information, pressure class, flow rate, installation date, water source, elevation details,  and coordinate values.

Geographic Coverage

The service covers Westbank First Nation lands in the Central Okanagan area of British Columbia.

Use Cases

  • Fire response planning and hydrant location lookup
  • Water infrastructure and asset management
  • Field inspection and maintenance support
  • Supporting municipal and emergency service coordination

Access and Licensing

The service is hosted by the GIS Section of the Regional District of Central Okanagan and maintained by Westbank First Nations. It is made available under the Regional District of Central Okanagan Open Data License and associated terms of use.
